extracted.name: Parmesan Crusted Tilapia Fillets
extracted.description: This Parmesan-crusted tilapia uses a few simple ingredients that pack a lot of great flavor. This is a quick, easy dinner, baked to perfection.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Whisk Parmesan cheese, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper together in a shallow dish.
Coat tilapia fillets with olive oil and press into the Parmesan cheese mixture. Arrange coated fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily with a fork, 10 to 12 minutes.
